opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: offers up to £500,000; in special cases, and by prior agreement, up to £750,000; most grants awarded are below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from UK-based organisations. Not funded: individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution for the duration of the project; projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organisation; projects led by schools or further education colleges; projects led by undergraduates or master's students; PhD fees or projects mainly supporting a PhD; establishment of academic posts; ongoing costs or rolling out existing work; dissemination-only projects; local charities or statutory funding replacement; requests for financial help/educational fees from individuals. In exceptional cases overseas organisations may apply if no UK-based host is feasible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged. One deadline a year in the Autumn.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme: Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. Funded by an endowment supporting work relating to the Commonwealth.
